summary_markdown: A discussion occurred regarding the feasibility of sending real-time performance metrics. [p1] inquired if it was possible to stream data such as impressions, reach, and frequency in real time. [me] clarified that while these metrics can be generated through a model, they are not yet available for real-time streaming. However, approximate data based on previous days is currently possible.
decisions: Real-time streaming of impressions, reach, and frequency is not currently supported.
